name: advisorppc
description: Work on your real ad accounts from Claude Code: audit Google Ads campaigns, pull performance reports across Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Search Console and YouTube, inspect Tag Manager setups, build shareable dashboard and audit pages, and, on paid plans with your approval, pause, enable and change budgets, bids and keywords.
